note: The walker (doc 23, presence below; approved October 21, 2026). You, on foot: tap a spot and the figure walks there along the walk grid. grid: cells of cellM meters over the open land; a cell is walkable if its slope is under maxSlopeDeg; a step between neighbours may climb at most maxStepM (a cliff face is more); water over a cell right now must be shallower than wadeM (knee deep). wadeCost makes wading slower to choose than dry ground. snapM: a tap on a spot you can't stand on walks to the nearest one within this reach. pace: one calm stroll that eases to a creep within creepNearM of a creature, a double tap within doubleTapMs hurries (brisk); in water deeper than wadeAnkleM the walk slows to wadeMps, hurrying or not (October 21, 2026: slower paces for the short-legged figure; October 22, Matt: stroll 1.5 and brisk 2.7, both faster; October 26, Matt, faster again: walk 2.2, brisk 4.2 (also the run with Shift held), creep 0.45 (the plan's 0.6 is faster than a frog's calm pace of 0.5 and would startle it; keep creep under every species' presence.calmSpeed), wade 1.0, accelMps2 14.7, about 0.15 s to full pace, and turnDegPerS 720); accelMps2 eases speed changes, turnDegPerS how fast the figure turns. camera: the low view behind you, distanceM its zoom range, startM where a glide down lands, pitchDeg the look up and down range (negative looks up), startPitchDeg the glide's pitch, lookHeightM where it aims on you, minEyeHeightM how low the eye may come over ground or water; orbitDegPerPx, how far a drag turns the view below (degrees a pixel; October 23, 2026, F16: well under half the view from above), and turnHalfLifeS, how softly the turn eases in (October 21, 2026: all four brought in by 0.737 with the figure, now drawn 1.4 m tall, not 1.9 m, so creatures read larger beside you). The figure itself is recipes/world/figure.json. tide: retreat to dry ground when the water ahead passes wadeM. words: the lines the island says.

steer.note: Walking with the keys (WASD, October 26, 2026; Matt: the standard PC third-person scheme). W A S D and the arrows walk relative to the camera at the pace's stroll, Shift held runs at briskMps, and near a creature the walk creeps as a click walk does (Shift still hurries, and can startle). Each step follows the walk grid's rules and slides along an edge that blocks it. profiles: the feel, island now and hollow later (the walk lab switches them): accelS to full pace, stopS to a stop, turnDegPerS how fast the walker turns to the keys' way (eightWay faces it at once, in eight directions), turnSlowFloor the least share of the pace kept while turning sharply (so a U-turn is a tight arc), creep whether creatures slow you. roll: Space, a dodge roll of distM in durS the way you move (or face), then waitS before the next. Its way is set when it starts (keys and the camera cannot turn it), and coming out of it you carry on that way for carryS, easing to the pace the keys ask for. Rolling (Matt, October 26, 2026), steep slopes are no bar and you go off any edge, falling at fallMps2; deep water, solid things and a face too high to climb stop it short. look: the mouse turns the camera under pointer lock, degPerPx a pixel, eased over halfLifeS (much quicker than a drag's turnHalfLifeS). panPxPerS: from above, W A S D pan the diorama as fast as a drag of this many pixels a second.

solids.note: Solid things you cannot walk through (Matt, October 26, 2026: no standing inside the workbench; src/world/walk/solids.js): camp pieces, logs, stones and the like, each a circle or a turned rectangle. bodyM: the walker's half width, how far it keeps its middle from a solid's edge. Small things you walk over (twigs, pebbles, shells, low plants) are never solids.

presence.note: You on foot as creatures feel you (W3): heightM is how far your body is over your feet in each posture (where the ring is measured from, and where the view aims). Set for the 1.4 m figure (October 21, 2026: 0.737 of the 1.9 m numbers). Posture and gaze stretch or shrink each species' comfort ring by its presence.multipliers.

ground.note: The ground bar (W4): Feed kneels and puts food down feedAheadM in front of you. Net is picked into your hand like a seed and set where you click (D1a; recipes/world/sowing.json net).

click.note: One click walks and uses (Matt, October 22, 2026; Look retired). A thing (a plant, a find, a keepsake, a log or stone, a net, a pile) walks you to within thingReachM beyond its own ring and opens its card on arrival. A creature's card opens where you stand within creatureCardM (you never walk up to it, so a click never startles); further off you walk until that close. Ground that is everywhere (grass, sand, pebbles, the strandline) opens a card only when something lies there to gather: within nearLookM of you at once, further off after walking up to it like a thing. Plain ground never opens a card; a click just walks there. hoverHz: how often the pointer is read for the hand cursor. The name tag (F4, October 23, 2026) shows only once the pointer rests on a thing hoverRestS seconds (moving less than hoverRestPx), fades in over hoverFadeS, and sits over the thing, never following the pointer; moving onto another thing hides it until a new rest.

words.lowTideHour: Low tide in about an hour.
words.cantReach: You can't get there on foot.
words.stuckFine: You can walk on from here.
words.feedNone: Nothing here knows to come for food yet.
